title: Explicit Hamiltonian ball packings in every dimension
description:
Version 1.1.0. Three papers, supplements, a Lean 4 formalisation and a numerical program, by Liang Song.

Paper I (equal balls in the four-ball): for every integer k ≥ 10 and ε ∈ (0,1), one explicit smooth compactly supported Hamiltonian whose time-one map packs the k closed unit balls in the four-ball of radius (k/(1-ε/4))1/4, with density 1-ε/4 and an explicit stability margin; previously such packings were known only through Biran's existence theorem, and explicitly only for square k. Paper II (general capacities and higher dimensions): one explicit Hamiltonian for all admissible data, realising in dimension four every packing with Σci2 < C2, 3ci < C, and in dimensions 2n ≥ 6 every packing allowed by the volume and two-ball inequalities; Biran's theorem for k ≥ 9 equal balls without J-holomorphic curves; a uniform terminating algorithm whose output is a rational polynomial times a fixed cutoff. Paper III (elementary packings of the four-ball and their limits): n(n+1) balls at density 1-1/(2n+1)2, density ≥ 1-1/√k for every k, ten balls at 360/361, and three obstructions explaining the limits of these methods.

The main theorems of Papers I and II are verified in Lean 4 with the pinned Mathlib dependency; the Lean development is unchanged from version 1.0.1. Paper III is not formalised. program/ is a numerical implementation for the Epoch AI interface built from Paper III's constructions; its correctness is supported by numerical integration, not proved, and the Hamiltonians it returns are smooth near the ball trajectories but not globally.

Changes from 1.0.1. The single paper is split into Paper I (equal balls in the four-ball) and Paper II (general capacities, higher dimensions, the algorithm); Paper III and program/ are new. Lean sources, statements and proofs are unchanged. See PROVENANCE.md.

Source and verification guide: https://github.com/s-JoL/Symplectic-Ball-Packing. License: Apache-2.0; vendored components retain their original notices.
